tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: App canvas (sage in light, true neutral in dark) behind panels and the top bar and rail.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Panels, cards, dialogs, sheets, popovers and input fills.

tokens.name: text
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg and surface (well above 7:1 in both themes).

tokens.name: muted
tokens.usage: Supporting text: help copy, timestamps, footer status, empty states. 5.4:1 on bg and 6.2:1 on surface in light; above 7:1 in dark.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline 1px card and panel edges and dividers. Decorative separation only.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The data green: a chart's main series, newest data, focus rings, checked controls and switches, selected provider cards. NOT the button fill (see primary).

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill. Kept for compatibility; same values as primary-foreground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Error text, destructive menu items and destructive actions (same values as negative). Always paired with words, never color alone.

tokens.name: raised
tokens.usage: Hover rows, user chat turns, settings panels, the reading-queue strip.

tokens.name: active
tokens.usage: Active nav item, selected list row, menu hover (color-accent / color-secondary).

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Row rules inside tables and lists, flat loading bars.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Input, select and outline-button borders: one step stronger than line.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Button fill and chrome emphasis: near-black in light, inverted (light) in dark.

tokens.name: positive
tokens.usage: Positive change and OK state; always with a sign or word.

tokens.name: negative
tokens.usage: Negative change and error state; always with a sign or word.

tokens.name: pill-positive-bg
tokens.usage: Positive pill fill (pair with pill-positive-fg).

tokens.name: pill-positive-fg
tokens.usage: Text on the positive pill.

tokens.name: pill-negative-bg
tokens.usage: Negative pill fill (pair with pill-negative-fg).

tokens.name: pill-negative-fg
tokens.usage: Text on the negative pill.

tokens.name: pill-warning-bg
tokens.usage: Warning pill fill (pair with pill-warning-fg).

tokens.name: pill-warning-fg
tokens.usage: Text on the warning pill.

tokens.name: color-data
tokens.usage: Tailwind alias (text-data, bg-data): the data green for checked states, switches and brand mark.

tokens.name: color-background
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (bg-background): dialog, sheet and tab-active fills.

tokens.name: color-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (text-foreground).

tokens.name: color-popover
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias: dropdown and select content.

tokens.name: color-popover-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias: text inside popovers.

tokens.name: color-border
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (border): default border color of generated primitives.

tokens.name: color-ring
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (ring): focus rings on dialog close, tabs, sheet close.

tokens.name: color-accent
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (bg-accent) — NOT the data accent: the quiet hover/highlight fill for menu items and the TabsList track.

tokens.name: color-accent-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias: text on color-accent.

tokens.name: color-muted-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (text-muted-foreground): descriptions, shortcuts, menu icons.

tokens.name: color-destructive
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (text-destructive): destructive menu items.

tokens.name: color-input
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (border-input): outline and input borders.

tokens.name: color-primary
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (bg-primary, text-primary): the near-black ink (light on dark). Buttons and chrome emphasis. For green data use color-data / color-ring.

tokens.name: primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a primary fill.

tokens.name: color-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (text-primary-foreground).

tokens.name: color-secondary
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (bg-secondary): quiet secondary button and chip fill.

tokens.name: color-secondary-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias: text on color-secondary.

tokens.name: destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a destructive fill.

tokens.name: color-destructive-foreground
tokens.usage: Tailwind/shadcn alias (text-destructive-foreground).

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Main series (the data green).

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Comparison series in ink.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Secondary grey series.

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Tertiary light grey series.

tokens.name: chart-5
tokens.usage: Accent series, drawn dashed to separate it from series 1. One hue per chart; chart grid, axes and tooltips use line, muted, surface and text.

families.sans: var(--font-inter), Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", sans-serif

styles.name: page-title
styles.usage: The one h1 per page/panel. Source: clamp(22px, 4vw, 24px).

styles.name: dialog-title
styles.usage: Dialog, AlertDialog and Sheet titles (shadcn text-lg font-semibold).

styles.name: brand-name
styles.usage: The wordmark in the top bar. There is no logo file; the name in this style IS the mark.

styles.name: eyebrow
styles.usage: Uppercase kicker above a page title (.brand), in accent.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Events shown in Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh. Occurred, observed, and valid times are separate.
styles.usage: Default body copy and control text.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Menu items, settings sub-nav, dialog descriptions, error messages.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Status values and secondary metadata, in muted.

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: Connection status does not indicate source freshness.
styles.usage: Connection footer and settings detail links, in muted.

spacing.note: DESIGN_SYSTEM.md fixes the scale at 4/8/12/16/24/32px. The legacy CSS still uses in-between steps (5, 7, 9, 14, 17, 18, 34px); new work snaps to this scale.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Menu/select content padding; icon-to-text nudges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons in an action row; menu item padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Input horizontal padding; gap between status cards.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Button horizontal padding; row vertical padding; status-card padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Shell padding; dialog padding; gap between nav column and main.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Content-panel padding at desktop (source clamps 20px–34px).

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Height of buttons, inputs and select triggers on fine pointers; 44px on coarse pointers (pointer-coarse / @media (pointer: coarse)). Theme options and bottom-nav tabs stay 44px+.

tokens.name: nav-width
tokens.usage: Desktop icon rail (logo at top, tooltip labels); becomes the labelled bottom bar at 720px and below. The top bar beside it is 48px.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs, alert dialogs, Sheet, auth panel (Tailwind rounded-xl, --radius-xl).

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, gadget frames, panels, sub-panels, popovers (Tailwind rounded-lg).

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, select triggers, theme options (Tailwind rounded-md).

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, checkbox box, select and menu items (Tailwind rounded-sm).

shadow.note: Borders do the separating; there are no resting shadows. Shadows exist only on floating layers (popover, dialog, composer).

tokens.name: shadow-popover
tokens.usage: Select content and dropdown menus.

tokens.name: shadow-dialog
tokens.usage: Command palette and modal dialogs.
